purpose: the confirmation freeze pre-registered that its two citation flags stay false until the independent audit passes; the audit has passed, so this record executes that pre-registered transition without editing any frozen artifact

pre_registered_condition.text_verbatim: these flags stay false until the independent audit passes; the development tasks that took part in building this host configuration are not in this batch, but the configuration itself was built with them, so this batch confirms the configuration on untouched tasks rather than establishing a general result

citable_as_saving.condition_met: the pre-registered condition was exactly 'until the independent audit passes'; the audit passed with complete=true, errors=[], usable_as_saving=true and an empty not_citable_statement
citable_as_saving.scope: this batch only, in this host configuration, on the three sealed tasks, at five repeats, measured in complete provider tokens with retries and summary tokens charged to their arm
citable_as_saving.does_not_mean: it does not mean compression alone saved anything, it does not mean the saving transfers to other host configurations, other hosts, other task shapes or other repeat counts, and it does not override the two negative pairs

citable_sentence_zh: 在该主机配置下（OpenAI Agents，结构化 JSON 合同 + 冻结渲染器 + 至多一次计费重试），对 3 个封存任务 × 5 重复 × 3 臂的 45 个样本，按全体配对的完整供应商 token 计（重试与摘要请求均计入所属臂），插件臂相对基线的配对均值为 +12.54%（13/15 配对为正，自助法区间 [+5.17%, +18.30%] 不含 0），三个任务的严格轨均不低于基线（各 5/5 对 5/5）；其中 2 个单元为负（−19.4%），成因是插件臂单向发生了一次修复重试，其输入（约 3.3k token）超过该单元的全部节省。同批原生摘要臂在同一口径下为 −13.25%（区间 [−17.06%, −10.04%]）。本批为该配置在未触碰任务上的确认，不构成跨宿主或跨配置的普遍结论。
citable_sentence_en: Under this host configuration (OpenAI Agents, structured JSON contract with the frozen renderer and at most one billed retry), on 45 samples (3 sealed tasks x 5 repeats x 3 arms), the plugin arm's paired mean saving over the baseline in complete provider tokens, with retries and summary requests charged to their arm, is 12.54 percent (13 of 15 pairs positive, bootstrap interval [5.17, 18.30] percent excluding zero), and the strict track is at least the baseline's on every task (5/5 versus 5/5 each). Two units are negative (-19.4 percent) because the plugin arm spent a unilateral repair retry whose input (about 3.3k tokens) exceeded that unit's entire saving. The native summarisation arm is -13.25 percent on the same basis (interval [-17.06, -10.04] percent). This batch confirms the configuration on untouched tasks; it does not establish a general result across hosts or configurations.

integrity.modules_verification_note: all five host-configuration module hashes recorded in the freeze were recomputed from the files on disk when this record was written and they still match, so no pinned source has changed since the freeze

still_not_established: generality across host configurations, hosts, task shapes or repeat counts
that the plugin is preferable in every unit: two of fifteen pairs are negative in this very batch
whether the unilateral repair retry on django_db_cache_cull_none was induced by the pruned context; five repeats cannot separate an arm effect from an answer-format effect
that the three sealed tasks can be used to confirm anything again: they are spent once and are never replaced by another id
